caption: The drawing depicts a single object, a small bottle with a rounded body and a short, narrow neck, which flares slightly at the opening. The bottle is predominantly green with a yellowish undertone and is speckled with brown, orange, and yellow spots distributed unevenly across its surface. The bottle sits on a flat, rectangular, wooden surface with a pattern of diagonal lines near the front edge. The background is plain and light in color. At the top of the image, the words "SMALL BOTTLE EARLY 19TH. CENTURY" are printed in uppercase letters.
title: Bottle
